verdict.rationale: Activepieces has related governance features (sensitive-flow publish review requiring PUBLISH_SENSITIVE_FLOW_ACCESS permission, agent approval gating in the AI agent builder where 'anything you want to check first waits for your approval'), suggesting some human-in-the-loop capability exists, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'pause and wait for approval/input' step or action within a flow itself. missing for 10: explicit docs on a flow-level pause/wait-for-approval step or human input action, evidence of how a paused flow resumes after approval, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific capability.
